events.title: Office TD - Steam NEXT FEST Giveaway
events.summary: Good-day EmployeesWe will be doing a key giveaway every day of Steam NEXT FEST!Every day @ 10:00 Pacific Time we will be posting a picture of an office layout made in our level editor and it will be your job to identify where it's from. You will need to send in your guess and your steam id to an event email. We will do a drawing from the correct answers each day for the winner of that day. Winners will get a key to the final release of the game!Follow to be ready to answer when we go live!
